capability.summary: Lay out every legend block on the same edge through one deterministic lane instead of independent plot-relative anchors.

decisions.reason: Per-family absolute coordinates cannot prevent sibling overlap or preserve convergence after edits.
Final placement must not depend on authoring call order or incidental object enumeration.
Side legends should read as one aligned vertical lane.
Multi-legend rows should read from the plot's left edge in stable order instead of preserving separated absolute alignments.
Every family on one row must align both its title and its graphical object with one 12-pixel gap.
A left-positioned title should create one reading line for categorical and continuous legend families.
The approved horizontal comparison needs clearer separation while existing side-lane rhythm remains unchanged.
The existing Canvas contract forbids silent expansion, relocation or content loss.

nonGoals: public legend block order or gap options
new legend families or renderer primitives
responsive layout or a generic collision solver
